scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,blue "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.stop: sh -c 'for p in 5174 18080 8080; do ids=$(lsof -ti tcp:$p 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$ids" ]; then kill $ids 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done'
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pi-dashboard/shared && npm run build -w @pi-dashboard/server && npm run build -w @pi-dashboard/web
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @pi-dashboard/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pi-dashboard/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pi-dashboard/server && npm run typecheck -w @pi-dashboard/web
